eyebrow: Pulling the dictionary from the real schema
code:
SELECT c.TABLE_SCHEMA, c.TABLE_NAME, c.COLUMN_NAME,
       c.DATA_TYPE, c.CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH, c.IS_NULLABLE
FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS AS c
WHERE c.TABLE_NAME IN ('Customers', 'Orders', 'Products')
ORDER BY c.TABLE_NAME, c.ORDINAL_POSITION;
caption: Real structural facts from Atlas — faster and more accurate than writing the dictionary from memory.
